rfam.comment: miR-16, miR-15, mir-195 and miR-457 are related miRNA precursor sequences (MIPF:MIPF000006). This miRNA family appears to be vertebrate specific and members of this family have been predicted or experimentally validated in a wide range of vertebrate species (MIPF:MIPF0000006). miR-16 and miR-15a are clustered within 0.5 kb at 13q14 in human, a region shown to be deleted or down-regulated in more than half of B cell chronic lymphocytic leukaemias (CLL) [1]. The hairpin precursors (represented here) are predicted based on base pairing and cross-species conservation -- their extents are not known. In this case the mature sequence is excised from the 5' arm of the hairpin. The structure of mir-16 has been reported in PDB: 6LXD, 6V5B and 6V5C [2,3].
